objective: GATE 3F-C SOFTRESTAURANT CANARY PLAN CERTIFICATION. Usar solo evidencia runtime READ ONLY para certificar si existe un plan de canary de pago de compra determinista y fail-closed, sin ejecutar writes. Confirmar shape de pagosproveedores, tratamiento observado de enviadoacentral, ausencia de PK/unique, capacidad de lookup por tupla exacta y confirmacion del saldo mediante las vistas canónicas. No autorizar canary si falta un criterio determinista de identidad o confirmacion.

queries.name: f3c_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3c_payment_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3c_index_shape
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.pagosproveedores') ORDER BY i.index_id

queries.name: f3c_enviadoacentral_shape
queries.sql: SELECT enviadoacentral,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.pagosproveedores GROUP BY enviadoacentral ORDER BY enviadoacentral

queries.name: f3c_exact_tuple_duplicate_groups
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT foliocompra,fecha,abono,referencia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores GROUP BY foliocompra,fecha,abono,referencia HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3c_purchase_reference_duplicate_groups
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT foliocompra,referencia FROM dbo.pagosproveedores WHERE foliocompra IS NOT NULL AND referencia IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(referencia))<>'' GROUP BY foliocompra,referencia HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3c_balance_views
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS view_name FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.type='V' AND o.name IN (N'AC_vwSaldoCxp',N'vwSaldoCxp') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: f3c_balance_view_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS view_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AC_vwSaldoCxp'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.vwSaldoCxp')) ORDER BY view_name,c.column_id

queries.name: f3c_related_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id) AS parent_object,t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger FROM sys.triggers t WHERE OBJECT_NAME(t.parent_id)=N'pagosproveedores' ORDER BY t.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows
Do not treat referencia alone as idempotency key
Exact tuple uniqueness is historical evidence only, not a schema guarantee
enviadoacentral semantics must not be invented beyond observed values
Canary confirmation must require both payment-row lookup and canonical balance observation
If deterministic identity/confirmation is insufficient, classify SOFT canary as BLOCKED_NOT_READY
Do not authorize or execute any canary
